description: What's my best way there? For a goal — a major or a job — and what the person brings (courses, exams, their Competency Selfie, work and life experience), the paths to it, each saying WHY it ranks where it does and naming the figures that moved it. The steps appear only where an agreement or pathway document states them, never assembled from award levels alone. Every item the person brought is marked counted, not counted or needs review and appears in the answer: nothing is dropped silently. A path missing an input is ranked with that gap named rather than penalised invisibly.

from_selfie.description: Optional: work the goals out from the package's Selfie: by (courses: its programs, CIP; careers: its occupations, SOC, with the occupations words reach), dimensions (Selfie dimension keys; all when none), band_at_least (a band key; supported_candidate when none), evidence_ids (only codes a link of whose chain was read from one of these documents; all when none), words (the work the person does now, with careers). The answer carries selfie_filters (the Selfie's dimensions and bands, and what was applied) and the package back

goal.description: A major (a major_minor_id or CIP) or a job (a SOC code)

goals.description: Optional: several goals, each a major or a job, whose paths are ranked together (at most 10); goal, goals or from_selfie is needed

held.description: Optional: courses and exams, the shape will_my_credits_transfer takes

package.description: Optional: the agent-held package, read by suggest_credit_for_my_learning. no copy is stored

state.description: Optional two-letter state: where they are

name: find_my_best_pathway

package.description: With from_selfie: the package back, for the caller to keep; no copy is stored

paths.description: One per path, ranked: rank, school, major, the goal that reached it (a job with its title, or a major), program, its facts (career targets, in_demand, modality, normal_length as printed, its checklist_id; each only where held), with a package the candidates it may meet in that checklist (package_candidates, never ranked on), what the person's credits are worth there, credits left, cost, earnings, payback, and why it ranks where it does

selfie_filters.description: With from_selfie: the Selfie's dimensions and bands, and the filters applied

steps.description: Shown only where an agreement or pathway document states them: documents lists them, or not_held says why none is shown

what_you_brought.description: Every item, marked counted, not counted or needs review, each with its reason

title: Find My Best Pathway
